title: Tech Note: Template Maker Component
author: Charlie Vass, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D Transformation Tags and the classic project-method/macro-based TemplateMaker approach are specific to Design Mode-era binary databases; while the transformation-tag mechanism itself still exists, this component-and-macro workflow for deploying live templates without redeploying the structure is less relevant in Project Mode-era 4D, where code and templates can be managed and deployed via Git-based CI/CD instead.
